_written: 2026-11-02, before any Figure 1 profile or footprint was computed. Grant figure (descriptive).

datasets.endogenous: HEK293T whole-genome Fiber-seq, reads overlapping DPAGT1 (data/kopah_restore/Hek293_Whole_Genome/target_bams/DPATG1_all_reads.bam)
datasets.construct_300bp_peak3: IGVF_construct_mix DPAGT13 (chr11:119,102,160-119,102,459; promoter, 300-600 bp upstream of the DPAGT1 TSS)

cell_line_assumption: plasmid transfections assumed HEK293T (to confirm with the user); endogenous data are HEK293T
subsampling: 300-bp constructs: samtools view -s (seed 42) to ~6,000 reads per construct per replicate from the aligned source BAMs (reps 1 and 2); full-length construct and endogenous: all reads

read_filters.plasmid: primary, aligned to the construct contig, spanning the construct end-to-end within 50 bp (full-length linear molecule); treated = m6A/AT >= 0.05 (excludes the untreated component); resolvable = largest fiberhmm footprint < 30% of the read
read_filters.endogenous: primary reads covering the whole 4.1-kb window; same m6A/AT >= 0.05 filter

footprints: fiberhmm-call --enzyme hia5 --seq pacbio --min-mapq 0 (linear mode; reads are linearised NotI or genomic), default model; size classes: TF-size 10-40 bp, PIC-size 41-80 bp, nucleosome >= 85 bp
profiles: per hg38 position: fraction of molecules covered by each size class, and m6A fraction over A/T bases (accessibility), plasmid and endogenous computed separately and shown on the same hg38 axis
motifs: JASPAR 2026 / HOCOMOCO v14 scan of the 300-bp inserts (P < 1e-5) to label candidate TF footprints (e.g. CTCF)

panel_a_clusters._written: 2026-11-02, before clustering was run (user request: cluster 4.1-kb plasmid reads to show grouping of sub-nucleosome footprints and accessibility in the 300-bp region). Display choice, descriptive.
panel_a_clusters.features: FIRE peak 1 300-bp region chr11:119,100,271-119,100,570 in 10-bp bins; per bin the majority state: accessible (no footprint), 20-35, 35-50, 50-90 bp footprint, nucleosome (>= 90 bp); one-hot
panel_a_clusters.clustering: Ward hierarchical clustering (Euclidean on one-hot), 4 clusters; clusters ordered by their share of accessible bins; reads within a cluster in dendrogram leaf order
panel_a_clusters.display: 60 molecules sampled across clusters in proportion to cluster size (seed 20261102), at least 6 per cluster; cluster share of all 488 molecules labelled
panel_a_clusters.occupancy_tracks: smoothing from the raw per-base shares with Gaussian sigma 3 bp (LRSS used 10 bp); solid fills, no lines; footprint bins x5 on the 300-bp track only; layers drawn tallest first so the shortest peaks are in front

fp_bins_v2._written: 2026-11-02, after the footprint-size scan (fig1_fpsizes.py) and before draft 6; bins chosen by the user from the scan (post hoc, data-derived, descriptive figure)
fp_bins_v2.below_15: calls < 15 bp are not drawn and not counted in any track (short fixed-position calls, likely AT-poor gaps; not verified)

panel_a_accessible._written: 2026-11-02, before draft 6 (user: show only accessible reads with sub-nucleosome footprints, add the CTCF motif). Replaces panel_a_clusters for display.
panel_a_accessible.reads: 300-bp construct DPAGT11 molecules spanning chr11:119,100,271-570 (within 20 bp), accessible (nucleosome calls >= 90 bp cover < 50% of the region) and with >= 1 footprint 15-89 bp whose midpoint lies in the region (fig1_fpsizes definitions)
panel_a_accessible.display: 40 molecules drawn at random (seed 20261102), ordered by Ward clustering (one-hot of 10-bp majority states over the region, fp_bins_v2) in leaf order; footprints only, zoomed to the 300-bp region, with the gene model above (region highlighted, zoom lines) and the HOCOMOCO v14 CTCF motif (119,100,436-455, P 3.8e-6) as a track
panel_a_accessible.panel_b: footprint tracks recomputed from this project's FiberHMM calls (fig1/profiles molecules: endogenous, DPAGT11) with fp_bins_v2: per base, molecules with a call of the class covering it / molecules covering it (span of observed A/T; 300-bp construct limited to its insert); Gaussian sigma 3 bp within covered runs; FIRE layer stays from the LRSS table (FIRE BAMs, independent of footprint bins); sub-nucleosome bins x5 on the 300-bp track only

panel_a_ctcf._written: 2026-11-02, before draft 7 (user: 4.1-kb reads, only CTCF-sized footprints, 10-20 reads clustered on that footprint). Replaces panel_a_accessible for display.
panel_a_ctcf.reads: 300-bp construct (DPAGT11) molecules spanning the CTCF motif (chr11:119,100,436-455) with a 31-60 bp call overlapping it by >= 10 bp: 765 of 9,498 (fig1_ctcf_reads.py)
panel_a_ctcf.availability: 4.1-kb construct: 2 of 488 molecules qualify; 300-bp construct (DPAGT11): 765 of 9,498; endogenous: 1 of 22. The 4.1-kb construct cannot supply 10-20 reads, so draft 7 draws them from the 300-bp construct pending the user's decision (--reads flag selects the source).
panel_a_ctcf.display: 15 molecules drawn at random (seed 20261102), ordered by Ward clustering of per-base 31-60 bp call occupancy over the motif +/- 60 bp (leaf order); drawn over the whole 4,774-bp NotI-linearized plasmid (plasmid coordinate = hg38 - (insert hg38 start - insert construct start), from inserts.tsv): nucleosome calls (>= 90 bp) and 31-60 bp calls only; plasmid map shows backbone, 300-bp insert and CTCF motif (no backbone feature annotation is available, so none is drawn)
panel_a_ctcf.panel_b: endogenous track: nucleosome and FIRE only (no sub-nucleosome footprints); plasmid 300-bp track: all bins, sub-nucleosome x5; CTCF motif marked on the gene model and across both tracks
panel_a_ctcf.renders: PDF/PNG via rsvg-convert with tools/r01_figure/fonts.conf (Arial -> Arimo, metric-compatible), so previews match the SVG layout
panel_a_ctcf._revised: 2026-11-02, before draft 7 was rendered: user chose the 300-bp construct reads, drawn along the whole linearized plasmid, clustered on the CTCF footprint
